newsitem.title: UK: Wasatch Insurance buys Transunion Casualty - AM Best.
newsitem.headline: Wasatch Insurance buys Transunion Casualty - AM Best.

text.p: Wasatch Crest Insurance in Salt Lake City has acquired Iowa-based Transunion Casualty Co. from AUSA Holding Co., a unit of Dutch insurer Aegon NV, according to AM Best.
Transunion will add to the services Wasatch Crest provides to businesses in the Midwest and Rocky Mountain states such as Utah.

"This acquisition will enable Wasatch Crest to improve service to our Utah customers with employees in other states," said Wasatch Crest chairman and chief executive Orrin T. Colby Jr, the AM Best agency reported.
"It also gives us the capability to enhance existing service in Iowa while expanding other financially solid insurance products to new markets."
Wasatch Crest will move Transunion's offices to Salt Lake City and will hire additional employees to handle Transunion's claims and operations.
